ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.label: Stone Skin
ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.description: Temporarily hardens the Gu Master's skin. Sharp armor +30 percentage points, blunt armor +25 percentage points. Heat armor and movement speed are unaffected.

effectNotes.li: Sharp armor +30 percentage points and blunt armor +25 percentage points while active.
Toggle on for 2 primeval essence, then pay 1 every 250 ticks. The first interval is included.

limitations.li: Ends on deactivation, missed upkeep, incapacitation or loss of the granting Gu or aperture.
